name: amt-gateway-iwa
description: Blockcast AMT Gateway - Isolated Web App (Cross-platform: macOS/Linux)

scripts.build: cd ../ && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -o iwa-amt-gateway/amt-client.wasm ./cmd/wasm-client && cd iwa-amt-gateway && webpack --config webpack.wbn.js
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean:dist && npm run build
scripts.build:dev: cd ../ && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -o iwa-amt-gateway/amt-client.wasm ./cmd/wasm-client && cd iwa-amt-gateway && webpack --config webpack.dev.js
